title: Prose for a Painting
answer_short: Poor style transfer accuracy when training data lacks similar words, and absence of a large supervised dataset for painting-to-Shakespearean prose mapping
answer_rationale: The authors demonstrate two key limitations: (1) poor style transfer accuracy when the training dataset lacks similar words, as shown in Figure FIGREF12 for 'Starry Night' with low content scores; and (2) the absence of a large supervised dataset for painting-to-Shakespearean prose mapping, which motivates their use of an intermediate English poem description and style transfer approach.
